description: This PHP source file defines the WebDriverHelper class in the Helper namespace, which provides methods for retrieving configuration and environment variables related to WebDriver setup, database configuration, administrative credentials, and third-party services such as BrowserStack within a testing framework.

classes.name: WebDriverHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to retrieve configuration and environment variables needed for WebDriver setup and integration with various services during tests.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration from the WebDriver module.

methods.name: getInstanceURL
methods.description: Retrieves the instance URL from environment variable or configuration, defaulting to 'http://localhost/'.

methods.name: getDatabaseDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the database driver setting, defaulting to 'MYSQL'.

methods.name: getDatabaseName
methods.description: Retrieves the database name, defaulting to 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getDatabaseHost
methods.description: Retrieves the database host, defaulting to 'localhost'.

methods.name: getDatabaseUser
methods.description: Retrieves the database user, defaulting to 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getDatabasePassword
methods.description: Retrieves the database password, defaulting to 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getAdminUser
methods.description: Retrieves the admin username, defaulting to 'admin'.

methods.name: getAdminPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the admin password, defaulting to 'admin'.

methods.name: getElasticSearchHost
methods.description: Retrieves the ElasticSearch host, defaulting to 'localhost'.

methods.name: getBrowserStackUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the BrowserStack username, defaulting to empty string.

methods.name: getBrowserStackAccessKey
methods.description: Retrieves the BrowserStack access key, defaulting to empty string.

methods.name: getBrowserStackLocalFolderURL
methods.description: Retrieves the BrowserStack local folder URL, defaulting to empty string.
